Identity confirmation FIRST per dispatch brief: 'The Bush' independently verified as a real, currently-operating lesbian/queer bar at 333 Troutman St Store 4, Bushwick, Brooklyn (near Maria Hernandez Park, corner Troutman St/Irving Ave) — not nightlife-by-default assumption, confirmed via nine independent sources: official site (bushbk.com), Time Out New York feature (Ian Kumamoto, 'Out Late: The Bush is igniting a lesbian cultural renaissance'), Wine Enthusiast feature, The Infatuation review, EveryQueer feature, Yelp listing, Apple Maps listing, RA.co and doNYC event-aggregator listings, GO Magazine event listing, and Instagram (@bushdykebar, corroborated via search rather than direct browse this session). Opened April 2023, owned/founded by Justine LaViolette and Nikke Alleyne, who met at Misster (the lesbian night at The Woods). Concept: cocktail bar plus dance floor built as a queer women/trans/non-binary social and romantic space, explicit intentional focus on centering queer people of color. Regular programming: Martini Tuesdays, Slutty Punch Wednesdays, DJ/dance weekends, monthly Dyke Drag, karaoke, trivia, watch parties, comedy and book events, Sunday day-drink mimosa hours. No single far-out ONE-OFF dated event could be confirmed as still upcoming (GO Magazine's 'Thursdays at The Bush' listing is a recurring weekly slot, not a genuine one-off date, so it is not nested here per near-events discipline) — this is a correct 'nothing genuine to nest' outcome, not a skipped check.
